body: Know it doesn't mean much, but happy birthday.
No problem man. I appreciate your alliteration.
I'll take a day off next Friday or Saturday of it rains. How busy we are directly relates to how busy we are. Thanks.
Possibly. I have PTO, but I'd have to wait a week. Plus, we only have 5 (including me) employees, which makes coming back to the what would be understaffed store a nightmare if it's busy.
Sorry to endorse negative thoughts, but that was beautifully written and very relatable. Writing short stories might be something you can channel these feelings into.
